body:
Im a 17 year old high-schooler who has tried a couple of other substances. Shrooms 3 times, 2c-e 3 times, 4-Aco-dmt Once, and Salvia 8 times. Im also a regular pot smoker.
I got 17mg of 2c-I from a friend for 12 dollars and took it on a Friday. I have no way of knowing if it was actually 2c-I and how much it was, but I trust this friend and don't believe he would scam me. When the pill capsule was put next to a capsule of 15mg's of 2c-e, the 2c-I was a slight off-white color and the 2c-e was white.
I took the 17mg's at 7:45am during first period of school. This school day the entire Junior class was going to Canobie Lake Park (an Amusement Park). We were leaving at 8:30. 8:30 rolls around and nothing has happened yet. We all file onto the buses. By 9 we head to Canobie and still nothing. 9:30 we are almost at Canobie and I can swear I feel something. Almost something...
By 10:30 Im in the park and nothing has happened yet. No tripping feeling, no visuals, no high... Nothing. Im skeptical now whether or not this is going to work.
Nothing ever ended up happening. There were only 2 things that I noticed from the 2c-I. One was that if something made me laugh, when I'd start laughing I would have a hard time stopping. Nothing to ridiculous, just I could feel myself laughing more than normal. The other 'thing' I noticed was a slight body high. When I opened my wallet pay for food at lunch time, I had a hard time using my muscles. As I went to grab my money my hand muscles were kind of shaky and I couldn't seem to grab the money.
